title: Merge two playlists, drop one track, create new playlist
system: You are a precise assistant with access to tools. Use the tools to look up data and perform actions; never invent track ids, playlist names, or confirmation codes. After tool results are returned, give a short final answer in English including any confirmation code.
user: I have two playlists, PL-101 and PL-202. Please look up the tracks in both, then create one new playlist named 'Road Trip Mix' that contains every track from both playlists exactly once, in the order they appear, but completely drop track T-904 from the result.

function.name: fetch_playlists
function.description: Fetch the track lists for one or more playlists by their comma-separated ids.

function.name: create_playlist
function.description: Create a new playlist from a comma-separated ordered list of track ids. Duplicates are not allowed in the list. Do not pass exclude_track_id; simply omit unwanted tracks from track_ids.

track_ids.description: Comma-separated ordered track ids, each appearing at most once

exclude_track_id.description: Optional; leave absent - unwanted tracks must simply be omitted from track_ids

failure.error: playlist lookup failed: pass both playlist ids PL-101 and PL-202 as a comma-separated string in the ids parameter
playlist creation rejected: name must be 'Road Trip Mix' and track_ids must be the deduplicated ordered union of both playlists with unwanted tracks omitted (do not pass exclude_track_id)
